NEW GIFT BUNDLE Herbal tea lovers will delight in this  Presentation Box Combo of two limited edition Warming Joy Herbal Presentation Box of 20 teas, for 40 herbal teas in all. An excellent gift for herbal tea lovers, as most teas are naturally caffeine-free. Pick up this limited edition bundle while supplies last. Save when you buy as a bundle!
 Note: One herbal blend in this collection contain trace amounts of naturally-occurring caffeine: Belgian Mint (cocoa husk). All other blends are naturally caffeine-free.
The Warming Joy Herbal Presentation Box Duo Gift Bundle is a $96 value and includes:

Two Warming Joy Herbal Presentation Boxes of 20 herbal pyramid tea infusers each
Each pyramid infuser steeps 8-12 ounces of tea
Each box measures 8.5L x 4.0D x 3.2H"
Please note: Pyramid infusers are not microwave-safe



All teas in this bundle are Kosher Certified
